messages:
Sam (EngMgr): Heads-up: scheduling the release-cut sync for v2.3. Proposed cut window: Thu Apr 15 09:30 PT. Please RSVP in-thread. Need ENG leads, SRE, Product, Security, Ops.

Jess (Product): Works for product. Can we include a short customer-impact matrix and a comms owner?

Tom (Backend): CR status: most merged. Blocking PR: api-rate-limiter #452. @Mira can you take a look today?

Mira (Infra): I'll triage #452 this afternoon. Also found a flaky in session-store on staging; may require a brief triage call pre-cut.

deploy-bot: CI: branch v2.3-main passed unit tests, integration running. Canary scheduled. <https://ci.redwood/v/2.3-main|ci link>

Lee (SRE): Ops checklist mostly done. Autoscale verified for projected QPS. Need KV restore runbook validation. @Ana are backups & restore steps green?

Ana (Ops): Backup rotation doc needs one final edit. I can run a test restore at 16:00 today and report back.

security-bot: Image scan: no critical findings. Full report: <https://sec.redwood/reports/2.3|sec report>

Sam (EngMgr): Draft agenda (please suggest edits):
```
1) Roll call & quick status (5m) - owners: Sam
2) Open blockers & PR triage (15m) - owners: ENG leads
3) Release checklist review (10m) - owners: SRE/Infra
4) Rollout strategy + canary thresholds (10m) - owners: Release Eng
5) Stakeholder signoffs & comms plan (10m) - owners: Product/Security
6) Post-cut monitoring + PD handoff (10m) - owners: SRE
```
Also proposing an optional 30m hotfix/triage slot immediately after the sync.

Jess (Product): Please add: "customer-impact matrix" as part of stakeholder signoffs and a short comms draft. I'll own comms.

Tom (Backend): RSVP: :+1: attending and can sign off if blockers cleared. FYI may need 1h on cut day if hotfix required.

Mira (Infra): :+1: will join and take infra triage. If #452 flakes CI, suggest creating hotfix branch and use post-sync triage slot.

Lee (SRE): :hand: attending but not primary signoff (travel). Ops can rubber-stamp if no infra regressions; @Sam please note in agenda.

Ana (Ops): :+1: Ops can run restore test at 16:00 and post results here.

Sam (EngMgr): Please paste outstanding PRs, runbook links, and the primary on-call/PagerDuty contact for post-cut handoff by EOD so I can finalize invite. I will send calendar invite for Thu Apr 15 09:30 PT plus 30m triage 10:00-10:30 PT.

Tom (Backend): Outstanding PRs: #452 (api-rate-limiter), #478 (prometheus tweaks), #460 (docs). I'll update PR descriptions with test plans.

Mira (Infra): Staging restore test scheduled 16:00 today. Will post results and link to runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/kv-restore.

Sam (EngMgr): Owners so far: Blockers/PRs - Tom; Release checklist - Lee; Infra/Triage - Mira; Stakeholder signoffs/comms - Jess. Please confirm or update.

Jess (Product): Confirmed for signoffs/comms. Will prepare a 1-slide customer-impact summary.

Tom (Backend): Confirmed for blockers. If hotfix needed, coordinate during triage slot.

Mira (Infra): Confirmed. If we need an emergency patch, I'll be on standby.

Sam (EngMgr): Final asks: 1) paste any other open PR numbers here, 2) list proxies if you can't signoff, 3) DM me if you expect to be :warning:.

Lee (SRE): Post-cut PD handoff: primary @Lee, secondary @Ana.

Ana (Ops): Restore test result: SUCCESS at 16:12, documented at https://runbooks.redwood/kv-restore (updated).

Sam (EngMgr): Great. I'll send invite and attach the meeting doc. After the sync, please add an explicit signoff emoji in this thread (:white_check_mark: or :x:).

Tom (Backend): Added note: if #452 still flaky, I'll open hotfix branch and notify here.

Mira (Infra): Posted quick log from staging failure and screenshot. If anyone needs repro commands I can paste them.

Sam (EngMgr): Thanks all. Will post the finalized agenda + invite by EOD. :rocket:
